name: Mall Glass Partition
summary: Full-height modular glazing bay with charcoal tracks, shared square end posts, centre mullion, transoms and four editable panes.
description: Original generic 1.20 m wide by 2.40 m high static mall partition for Singapore/Malaysia scenes. Repeat pitch 1.14 m measured between shared post centres. Distinct from the existing guardrail and hinged door; no opening or runtime interaction.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled materials; no third-party models, artwork, textures or fonts.

assembly.instructions: Align CONNECTOR_Right of a placed bay to CONNECTOR_Left of the incoming bay. Remove incoming POST_Left, keeping preceding POST_Right once. For straight runs offset root by 1.14 m. For right-angle joins rotate incoming bay about its left connector by +/-90 degrees. The square 60 mm shared post accepts either direction. layouts.json provides exact glTF +Y-up transforms; Blender positions map (x,y,z) to (x,-z,y) and rotationY maps to rotation Z with unchanged sign.

material_notes: 15 independently editable closed meshes: two posts, two tracks, centre mullion, two transoms, four 10 mm panes and four visibility bands. Three materials reuse the coherent shopfront charcoal/aqua/frosted palette. Alpha 0.22 blended glass is not physically refractive. No textures, animations or lights exported.
accuracy_notes: Generic static visualization only, not structural, safety, fire, accessibility, installation or building-code certification. Not a door or guardrail; no runtime interactions. Post joints and dimensions are scene-layout conventions, not engineering connection details.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local asset, source, studio and gallery visual gates PASS, with original/opaque/hidden checker transparency controls inspected. Actual Android/iOS remain NOT TESTED; overall NEEDS REVIEW is distinct from local visual approval. Static viewing only; no runtime interactions.
